meta.from: UX revamp C1 (ADR 0007): one scale, Notion style everywhere
meta.previous: v1: two tiers, work 13 px + page 15 px (imported 2026-09-23)

tokens.name: term-bg
tokens.usage: The recessed terminal canvas, one step below bg. Terminals and diffs only.

tokens.name: syntax-keyword
tokens.usage: Code editor syntax (GH #265). Keywords and operators that are words (if, return, fn). ≥ 4.5:1 on term-bg, its active line and a selection.

tokens.name: syntax-string
tokens.usage: Code editor syntax (GH #265). String and character literals, regular expressions. ≥ 4.5:1 on term-bg, its active line and a selection.

tokens.name: syntax-number
tokens.usage: Code editor syntax (GH #265). Numbers, booleans and other literal constants. ≥ 4.5:1 on term-bg, its active line and a selection.

tokens.name: syntax-comment
tokens.usage: Code editor syntax (GH #265). Comments. Read like the code, so held to 4.5:1 like it. ≥ 4.5:1 on term-bg, its active line and a selection.

tokens.name: syntax-function
tokens.usage: Code editor syntax (GH #265). Function and method names. ≥ 4.5:1 on term-bg, its active line and a selection.

tokens.name: syntax-type
tokens.usage: Code editor syntax (GH #265). Types, classes and namespaces. ≥ 4.5:1 on term-bg, its active line and a selection.

tokens.name: syntax-heading
tokens.usage: Code editor syntax (GH #265). Markdown headings: the ink at weight 600 — never red. ≥ 4.5:1 on term-bg, its active line and a selection.

tokens.name: syntax-link
tokens.usage: Code editor syntax (GH #265). Links and URLs in Markdown and comments. ≥ 4.5:1 on term-bg, its active line and a selection.

tokens.name: syntax-meta
tokens.usage: Code editor syntax (GH #265). Meta: attributes, annotations, processing instructions, front matter. ≥ 4.5:1 on term-bg, its active line and a selection.

tokens.name: syntax-invalid
tokens.usage: Code editor syntax (GH #265). Invalid syntax: amber, as every failure in Ply. ≥ 4.5:1 on term-bg, its active line and a selection.

tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: The window ground: the stage behind every page.

tokens.name: panel-bg
tokens.usage: The sidebar, groups of rows, board columns, the Settings shell.

tokens.name: raised
tokens.usage: One step up: cards on the board, popovers, menus, sheets. No shadow at rest.

tokens.name: fg
tokens.usage: Primary text on bg, panel-bg, raised and term-bg (≥ 13:1 in every theme).

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: hints, metadata, section labels, placeholders. ≥ 5:1 on every surface in every theme — safe at 12 px.

tokens.name: hover
tokens.usage: The hover wash on rows, nav items and quiet buttons.

tokens.name: selected
tokens.usage: The selected fill: the current nav item, the active tab, a selected list row. Neutral in every theme and preset.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers between rows, around groups and columns. Decorative: structure, never meaning.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Emphasised edges: sheets, popovers, the selected card.

tokens.name: border-control
tokens.usage: The edge of a text field, select or checkbox: ≥ 3:1 on bg, panel-bg and raised in every theme.

tokens.name: shell-accent
tokens.usage: A plain shell: its tile glyph and session dot. Text-safe (≥ 5:1).

tokens.name: claude-accent
tokens.usage: Claude and agents; the one identity hue. Primary buttons, links, the focus ring, the selected nav bar. Violet in every theme (accent-violet); a preset replaces it (see accent-*).

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a claude-accent fill (primary button). ≥ 5.7:1 in every theme.

tokens.name: accent-violet
tokens.usage: Preset violet: every theme's own claude-accent, so the default and the Violet choice paint the same.

tokens.name: accent-cyan
tokens.usage: Preset cyan. Light takes a deeper cyan so text stays ≥ 4.5:1.

tokens.name: accent-magenta
tokens.usage: Preset magenta.

tokens.name: accent-sunset
tokens.usage: Preset sunset: a warm rose, kept ≥ 30° of hue from signal-aborted-fg (failure amber) and ≥ 15° from signal-crashed-fg (crash red, QoL 1.168 A6) in every theme, so it reads as neither. 1.169.0: at that limit (hue 345°, the warmest it can be), and lighter than accent-magenta in the light theme (L 49% vs 42%) so the two presets read apart.

tokens.name: on-accent-preset
tokens.usage: Text on any preset fill: white on light, near-black on dark and void (≥ 5.3:1 for every preset).

tokens.name: ok
tokens.usage: Success copy and checks passed. Text-safe in every theme.

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: Warnings, failures, a stalled session. Amber is failure in Ply; red is for destruction and a crashed session only.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Destructive actions and their confirmation (Delete, Remove, Reset), and one state: a crashed session (signal-crashed-fg, QoL 1.168 A6).

tokens.name: on-danger
tokens.usage: Text on a danger fill (the confirm button).

tokens.name: danger-wash
tokens.usage: The ground of a danger zone or a destructive confirmation.

tokens.name: signal-running-fg
tokens.usage: Running: the dot and the word. Indigo, never the accent.

tokens.name: signal-running-bg
tokens.usage: Running: tint behind a status chip.

tokens.name: signal-done-fg
tokens.usage: Done: dot and word.

tokens.name: signal-done-bg
tokens.usage: Done: chip tint.

tokens.name: signal-aborted-fg
tokens.usage: Failed, stopped, timed out, blocked: dot and word. Amber — the failure colour.

tokens.name: signal-aborted-bg
tokens.usage: Failed and stopped: chip tint.

tokens.name: signal-empty-fg
tokens.usage: Empty, queued, not started: dot and word — the muted ink.

tokens.name: signal-empty-bg
tokens.usage: Empty: chip tint.

tokens.name: signal-crashed-fg
tokens.usage: QoL 1.168 (A6): a session that ended in a failure (a crashed tile): its words and a filled dot. The one state in red, so a dead tile is not read as a slow one or one that asks.

tokens.name: signal-stalled-fg
tokens.usage: QoL 1.168 (A6): working with no output for a while: the words and a hollow ring (never a filled dot).

tokens.name: signal-asks-fg
tokens.usage: QoL 1.168 (A6): a session waiting for you: the words, a filled dot and the tile's border.

tokens.name: signal-unsaved-fg
tokens.usage: QoL 1.168 (A6): a file with unsaved changes: a neutral dot (green means good elsewhere).

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Behind a sheet or the Settings modal.

families.ui: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI Variable Text", "Segoe UI", "SF Pro Text", "Helvetica Neue", sans-serif
families.mono: "SF Mono", ui-monospace, "Cascadia Mono", Consolas, Menlo, monospace

styles.name: display
styles.usage: The card page title and the empty-board question. One per screen.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: A page name: Inbox, a Settings page, a skill, the Library pages.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: A section inside a page: Needs you, Activity, What you want.

styles.name: subheading
styles.usage: A group heading, a sheet title, a column name on the board.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Reading text: row labels on pages, the brief, prose, one-sentence ledes.

styles.name: ui
styles.usage: The default for chrome: sidebar items, buttons, fields, menus, card titles on the board, list rows.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Secondary lines: a hint under a label, metadata, tile headers, toasts' second line.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: The smallest text in Ply: section labels in sentence case (never uppercase), counts, keyboard hints. Nothing is set below 12 px.

styles.name: mono
styles.usage: Machine text: paths, SHAs, commands, durations, the tile kind glyph. Terminals use their own 13 px xterm setting.

tokens.name: space-2xs
tokens.usage: Between a dot and its word, a count and its label.

tokens.name: space-xs
tokens.usage: Inside chips; between a label and its hint.

tokens.name: space-sm
tokens.usage: Between controls in a row; icon to label; card padding on the board (compact).

tokens.name: space-md
tokens.usage: Row padding (compact); the gap between board cards; sidebar inset.

tokens.name: space-lg
tokens.usage: Row padding (comfortable); card padding; page gutters on narrow windows.

tokens.name: space-xl
tokens.usage: Between groups on a page; around a callout; page gutters.

tokens.name: space-2xl
tokens.usage: Between sections on a page; header to first section.

tokens.name: space-3xl
tokens.usage: The top of a page; before a danger zone.

tokens.name: page-space-xs
tokens.usage: Legacy alias of space-xs (the page tier). Retire in C2.

tokens.name: page-space-sm
tokens.usage: Legacy alias of space-sm.

tokens.name: page-space-md
tokens.usage: Legacy alias of space-md.

tokens.name: page-space-lg
tokens.usage: Legacy alias of space-lg.

tokens.name: page-space-xl
tokens.usage: Legacy alias of space-xl.

tokens.name: page-space-2xl
tokens.usage: Legacy alias of space-2xl.

tokens.name: page-space-3xl
tokens.usage: Legacy alias of space-3xl.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Chips, tags, keyboard hints, the tile kind glyph.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Controls (buttons, fields, selects), board cards, tiles, list rows' hover.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Groups of rows, board columns, popovers, menus, callouts, the palette.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Sheets, the Settings modal, flows.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Dots, the switch, count badges.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Legacy (was 3 px); alias of radius-sm. Retire in C2.

tokens.name: radius-control
tokens.usage: Legacy alias of radius-md.

tokens.name: radius-menu
tokens.usage: Legacy (was 8 px); alias of radius-lg.

tokens.name: radius-group
tokens.usage: Legacy alias of radius-lg.

tokens.name: radius-surface
tokens.usage: Legacy alias of radius-xl.

tokens.name: shadow-popover
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers, the workspace switcher, the palette.

tokens.name: shadow-sheet
tokens.usage: Sheets and the Settings modal, over the scrim.

tokens.name: shadow-toast
tokens.usage: Toasts, bottom centre. Void draws a hairline instead: a shadow is invisible on black.

tokens.name: row-compact
tokens.usage: Least height of a compact row: sidebar items, menu items, list-view rows.

tokens.name: row-comfortable
tokens.usage: Least height of a comfortable row: Settings and Library rows, Inbox rows.

tokens.name: control-sm
tokens.usage: A small control: inside a board card, a tile header, a toast.

tokens.name: control-md
tokens.usage: Every other control: buttons, fields, selects, segmented.

tokens.name: icon-sm
tokens.usage: Icons in compact rows, chips and tile headers.

tokens.name: icon-md
tokens.usage: Icons in the sidebar, buttons and page rows.

tokens.name: icon-stroke
tokens.usage: Lucide stroke width, every size.

tokens.name: sidebar-w
tokens.usage: The sidebar's default width (resizable 200–320, collapses with ⌘\).

tokens.name: traffic-light-inset
tokens.usage: The room the traffic lights take at the screen header's left end when the sidebar is hidden.

tokens.name: stage-title-start
tokens.usage: Where a screen title starts: the header's inset, the sidebar toggle and their gap. A page body that lines up with its title starts here (GH #311).

tokens.name: stage-title-start-bare
tokens.usage: Where a screen title starts with the sidebar hidden.

tokens.name: board-inset
tokens.usage: The Board's left and right inset: its columns, list, status line, archive and the adoption banner all sit inside it (1.172.2, D6).

tokens.name: page-column
tokens.usage: The reading column of a page (Settings, a card, a skill).

tokens.name: page-column-wide
tokens.usage: List pages: Inbox, Library lists, the board's list view.

tokens.name: list-col-xs
tokens.usage: A list column for a short figure: a cost, an age (GH #248).

tokens.name: list-col-sm
tokens.usage: A list column for one word: the Builder, the checks, when it was updated.

tokens.name: list-col-md
tokens.usage: A list column for a short name or a state word: a workspace, a result.

tokens.name: list-col-lg
tokens.usage: A list column for a status that can run long; it truncates, the whole on hover. The title column takes what is left.

tokens.name: focus-w
tokens.usage: The focus ring: claude-accent, outside the control. ≥ 3:1 on every surface.

tokens.name: focus-offset
tokens.usage: Ring offset.

tokens.name: row-min
tokens.usage: Legacy alias of row-comfortable.

tokens.name: ctl-page
tokens.usage: Legacy alias of control-md.

tokens.name: dur-fast
tokens.usage: Hover reveals.

tokens.name: dur-base
tokens.usage: Popovers, sheets, row transitions.

tokens.name: dur-pulse
tokens.usage: The one pulse: a running dot. Stops under reduced motion.

tokens.name: ease-out
tokens.usage: Everything that opens or moves.
